title: BiblioTopic: browser-based bibliometrics and comparative topic modelling (LDA and BERTopic) for Web of Science and Scopus corpora
description: BiblioTopic is an open-source web application that runs entirely in the browser. It merges Web of Science and Scopus exports, computes bibliometric indicators, fits LDA and BERTopic topic models on a shared vocabulary, compares them (coherence, diversity, stability, Hungarian topic alignment, ARI/NMI, Topic Robustness Index, bootstrap confidence intervals), applies HJ-Biplot with cluster analysis, builds thematic maps and thematic evolution diagrams, supports blinded expert validation (ratings and word intrusion, Krippendorff's alpha), and drafts the Methods and Results sections of a manuscript.
